name: test-crypto-data
description: Recorded market data for Polymarket US crypto up/down markets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP; 5m, 15m, 1h): every trade and top-10 order-book change, plus Coinbase spot top-of-book once a second. One gzip JSON-lines file of each per UTC day, with coverage span, row counts, schema and sha256 in each record.

extensions.description: The Fangorn app this agent fronts.

skills.name: Search
skills.description: Find days of recorded data by meaning, e.g. 'Polymarket trades on 2026-11-14' or 'Coinbase top of book'. Each hit is one daily file record: its download URL, coverage span, row counts, schema and sha256.

skills.name: Repos
skills.description: Which repos this app follows and how many records each holds.

skills.name: Get
skills.description: One record live from Fangorn by id: pm-YYYYMMDD (Polymarket trades and book changes) or books-YYYYMMDD (spot top-of-book).
